title: Desktop spike: Electron shell, engine helper process, plugin hosting, signed macOS build
goal: Prove the process model and plugin hosting on Windows and macOS: Electron starts the engine helper, the UI connects with the token handshake, third-party VST3 and AU plugins load, save and restore state, report latency and open editors, and a signed and notarized macOS build runs.
done: JUCE desktop audio device (#20) covers the device half of JUCE hosting.
prerequisites: M3 protocol server (the renderer connects through it).

humanGates.text: Create a Developer ID Application certificate and a notarization API key in the maintainer's Apple Developer account, and approve storing them as GitHub Actions secrets.
humanGates.how: The maintainer logs in; Claude can drive the portal through Claude in Chrome with the maintainer present, and must ask before storing any secret.

humanGates.text: Judge editor-window focus and Cmd-Tab behaviour on a real Mac.
humanGates.how: The maintainer runs the signed build on a Mac and records the result; CI cannot judge window behaviour.

humanGates.text: Name one third-party VST3 and one AU plugin installed on the maintainer's machines for the hosting tests.
humanGates.how: The maintainer lists them; tests read their paths from SIANN_TEST_VST3 and SIANN_TEST_AU and SKIP with a message naming the variable when it is unset, and fail when it points at a missing file.
humanGates.resolvedBy: Fable consultation, delegated by the maintainer
humanGates.resolution: Windows VST3: TDR Nova (Tokyo Dawn Records; free, no account or licence server, has an editor, Precise/Insane quality modes report nonzero latency) at C:Program FilesCommon FilesVST3TDR Nova.vst3. macOS AU: TDR Nova AU from the same free installer at /Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/Components/TDR Nova.component (the maintainer installs it on the Mac). Fallback for either: TDR VOS SlickEQ. CI downloads no third-party plugins: the desktop job builds siann_test_plugin (JUCE; VST3 on all runners, AU on macOS) with a fixed declared latency switchable by a parameter and a versioned state blob, hosted through a compile-time path (SIANN_TEST_PLUGIN_VST3 / SIANN_TEST_PLUGIN_AU) so that test never skips; macOS CI also hosts Apple AUPeakLimiter as a foreign-vendor AU. Third-party state round-trips compare parameter values, not raw blobs. The third-party tests run only on the maintainer machines and gate m0-exit-plugins.

features.title: Electron app under app/ that spawns and supervises the engine helper
acceptance: app/ holds an Electron app (TypeScript, contextIsolation on, nodeIntegration off) that starts the engine helper, restarts it with crash-loop backoff and passes port and token to the renderer through preload.
Playwright (Electron) tests start the app, see the renderer connect with the token handshake, kill the engine and see it restart.

features.title: JUCE plugin hosting in the engine helper
acceptance: JucePluginHost implements PluginHost: scan, instantiate on the main thread, process on the audio thread, state get/set as blobs, latency and capability reporting.

Hosting tests load the maintainer VST3 (and AU on macOS) from SIANN_TEST_VST3 / SIANN_TEST_AU, and the CI-built siann_test_plugin, save and restore state, read latency (including a runtime latency change) and open and close the editor.
Windows editors are owned by the Electron window via GWLP_HWNDPARENT; macOS editors float and the engine activates itself.

features.title: macOS helper app bundle, hardened runtime, signing and notarization in CI
acceptance: The engine ships as SIANN.app/Contents/Helpers/SIANN Engine.app with LSUIElement=1 and com.apple.security.cs.disable-library-validation.
A macOS CI job signs with the Developer ID certificate and notarizes with the API key from secrets, then verifies with spctl and stapler.

exit.text: Engine starts and stops with the app; the renderer connects with the token handshake.
One third-party VST3 and one AU load, save and restore state, report latency and open editors.
exit.how: Hosting tests on the maintainer machines with SIANN_TEST_VST3 and SIANN_TEST_AU set; CI runs the same tests against siann_test_plugin and Apple AUPeakLimiter.

exit.text: A signed and notarized macOS build runs; focus and Cmd-Tab behaviour is acceptable.
exit.how: CI notarization plus the maintainer's hands-on check (human gate).

killCriterion: No acceptable editor-window behaviour on macOS after two weeks: evaluate engine-in-main-process or Tracktion with the maintainer.
